src.label: Seychelles National Biosecurity Agency — application to import live animals

head: You need a written veterinary import permit, applied for months ahead.
lines: Seychelles allows imports of live animals only through a written veterinary import permit. A permit covers one consignment and a limited period, and it cannot be transferred to another importer.

The application must be made at least four months before entry for animals from rabies-infected countries, and four weeks for rabies-free countries. If no permit arrives two weeks after applying, the form says to phone veterinary services.

The form asks for each pet's name, species, breed, sex, age, description and microchip number, plus the origin, transit airport and the final address in Seychelles. Original veterinary certificates are shown at the port of entry only, and CITES species need a certified CITES permit copy.
